name: CubingUSA Southern Championship 2024

venue.name: [Oklahoma City Convention Center](https://okcconventioncenter.com/)
venue.address: 100 Mick Cornett Dr, Oklahoma City, OK 73109

information: This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/) as the Southern [Regional Championship](https://cubingusa.org/regional) for 2024. The following states are eligible for the title of Southern Champion: - Arkansas - Louisiana - Mississippi - Oklahoma - Texas All competitors must read the [Important Information/FAQ tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2024#36706-important-information-faq) prior to registering. Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2024#competition-schedule) is tentative - we may adjust the exact starting time of each event based on the number of registered competitors, however we will not change the scheduled days of any first rounds. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaXRmIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9214a2ac7e84e29122d156f866079e025ede2826/image.png)
